description: Native contract 2.0 request cases. Python: RecommendationRequest.model_validate (valid <-> accepted; error is a substring of the validation message) and, for service_error cases (INVALID_FEEDBACK, STALE_REQUIREMENTS), the service after rounds v2-r1 (conversation v2-fixture) and v2-other-r1 (conversation v2-other). TS: nativeRequestSchema.safeParse (valid <-> success).

cases.name: contract-version-omitted
cases.note: Documented rule: an unversioned body is read as the current contract (same convention as contract 1.0, which also defaulted contract_version); an explicit 1.0 is rejected.

cases.name: browsing-missing-a-shown-listing
cases.error: exactly one record per shown listing

cases.name: browsing-for-unshown-listing
cases.error: exactly one record per shown listing

cases.name: draft-appointment-status
cases.note: Schema-valid; native rejects statuses outside ranking.behavior.counted_appointment_statuses. The TS sidecar never emits it.

cases.name: wrong-round-other-conversation
cases.note: v2-other-r1 is committed in conversation v2-other with the same listings.

cases.name: stale-requirements-changed-same-version
cases.note: Changed requirements (budget 3000 -> 2500) without a newer requirements_version than the head v2-r1 (1). The backwards-version branch needs a head above version 1 and is covered by recommendation/tests/test_recommendation.py::test_stale_requirements_version_backwards_or_changed_without_newer_version.
